title: acknowledgement ledger (.web-tops/acks.yaml)
description: The acknowledgements of soft laws (WEB_TOPS.md section 8.1) that are not written as a `// webtops-ack W-NN: reason` comment in source. An entry covers every finding of its law in its file.

reason.description: Why the break is accepted. It holds a letter or a digit: an empty or punctuation-only reason is no reason.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, valid through that day. An expired entry acknowledges nothing.
